meta.title: Medusa Ledger — Open Source Trust Ledger for Business
meta.description: Open source business trust ledger for verifiable events. Multi-stack SPEC: Node npm, Spring Boot, Docker WLL. SHA-256, append-only.

hero.title: Medusa Ledger — Open Source Trust Ledger for Business
hero.lead: Append-only SHA-256 ledger so anyone can prove business events — without replacing the ERP. You define the event. Medusa makes it verifiable.

split.title: Core vs Cloud
split.lead: Open the engine. Keep multi-tenant business features commercial.
split.oss_text: Blocks, hashes, events, verify, basic API, Docker, SDK, docs. Free to run locally.
split.cloud_text: Multi-tenant / white-label, payment anchors, analytics hubs, SLA, ERP connectors, hosting.

flow.title: How an event becomes proof
flow.lead: You define the event. Medusa makes it verifiable.

storage.title: Storage SPEC
storage.lead: Operational DB is state. Medusa is evidence. The chain lives next to the app — not in the other service’s Mongo.
storage.m2_text: Docker / K8s volume · HTTP append + verify from any language
storage.m3_text: Managed ledger per business unit · backups, anchors, multi-tenant

install.title: Install SPEC
install.lead: Same protocol. Pick the stack already in the project. Node is the hash reference in v0.1; Spring and .NET talk HTTP to the sidecar.
install.node_lead: In-process FileStore. No extra container required.
install.spring_lead: v0.1 starter calls the Docker sidecar. Native Java hash is v1.1.
install.docker_lead: Any language posts HTTP. Chain lives on the container volume.
install.dotnet_lead: HTTP client against the sidecar in v0.1. Native NuGet hashes in v1.2. Do not fork SHA-256 until SPEC is frozen.

quickstart.title: Quick start
quickstart.lead: Append ORDER_CREATED, then PAYMENT_RECEIVED, then verify. Same two events on every stack.
quickstart.spring_s1: Sidecar up, then Maven or Gradle
quickstart.note: Core v0.1 lives on main. Node hashes are canonical; Spring and .NET use the Docker sidecar until native SPEC hashes ship.

manual_teaser.title: Usage manual
manual_teaser.lead: Install, API reference, block/tx model, chain verify, and OSS limits.

sponsors.title: GitHub Sponsors
sponsors.lead: Core is open; Cloud is managed. Sponsors fund discovery and roadmap — not a back door into multi-tenant, payment hubs, or SLA.
sponsors.community_text: Medusa Core: blocks, hashes, events, verify, Docker, NPM, docs. Run the ledger on your disk.
sponsors.cloud_text: Hosted ledgers per unit, white-label, payment anchors, analytics, ERP connectors, SLA.

cta.title: Need hosted multi-tenant?
cta.text: Medusa Cloud runs isolated ledgers per business unit with analytics and payment anchors.
